outlook.statement: Will continue to invest in strengthening platforms, deepening industry-specific capabilities, expanding strategic partnerships, and taking solutions to wider markets; focus on building technology that is secure, scalable, relevant, and trusted by enterprises

SecureKloud remains committed to helping organizations build modern data ecosystems that transform information into actionable intelligence, enabling confident decisions, greater operational efficiency, and sustained business growth.

SecureKloud is committed to helping BFSI organizations build trusted AI ecosystems that combine innovation with accountability, deploying intelligent solutions with confidence, strengthening regulatory compliance, mitigating risk, and creating long-term business value.

DocuGenie.AI™ is being positioned as a common AI foundation that can be verticalized across industries and business processes, moving beyond generic document automation towards industry-led AI solutions.

Strategic focus for FY2026-27 and beyond centered on scale, accelerating enterprise adoption, expanding recurring platform revenues, and strengthening presence across high-growth industry verticals. For DocuGenie.AI™, immediate priority is deepening leadership within Lending ecosystem by expanding deployments across Banks, NBFCs, Affordable housing finance companies, Cooperative banks, and MSME lenders. Logistics platform will continue expanding through POD, warehouse documentation, freight invoice processing. Advancing commercialization of Healthcare offerings and continuing product development for Insurance sector. Long-term ambition for DocuGenie.AI™ to scale into AI-native digital workforce capability performing knowledge-intensive tasks across enterprise functions globally. iCMS expected to become important long-term growth driver as enterprises transition to intelligent cloud operations powered by AI, automation, predictive analytics, FinOps, and cloud governance. Will continue strengthening strategic partnerships with hyperscalers, technology providers, account aggregator ecosystems, channel partners, and cloud marketplaces to expand market reach.
the management has identified the ensuing three quarters of the financial year 2026–27 as the critical assessment period to evaluate the Company's operational and financial turnaround

The management has identified the ensuing three quarters of the financial year 2026–27 as the critical assessment period to evaluate the Company's operational and financial turnaround. In the event that the Company does not achieve the expected improvement during this period, the management will reassess the appropriateness of the going concern assumption, including the need to prepare the financial statements on a liquidation basis.
